lesson_title: Energy in a Squash and a Stretch
hook_text: A clothes peg, a clicky pen and a mattress all have the same secret.
clip_script: A box of springy things in Klerksdorp. Stretch an elastic band: feel it pull back? That is stored energy, from your muscles. Twist it: more energy. Squash a mattress spring: it pushes back. Springs hide in pens, pegs, staplers, taxis and trampolines. Now the test: stretch a band 5, 10, 15 centimetres. Let go. Further and further! More stretch, more stored energy. Too far? Snap!
visual_style: Whiteboard elastic band stretching along a ruler, then three flight paths getting longer, then a spring squashing.
mood: Bouncy and playful, like a toy box experiment.
pacing: Stretch, twist, squash, then the three-distance test and the snap.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find five springs hidden in your home.
